MECA.TITLE: NAVI AI-SHIFT Non-operating Conditions, Restrictions, etc.

ITEM.PTXT: Control is not performed under the following conditions.

INDICATE.TITLE: When NAVI AI-SHIFT Is Not Performed

ENTRY.PTXT: "Off" selected with the "NAVI AI-SHIFT On/Off" switch on the navigation screen
When the shift lever is in a position other than D
During cruise control operation
When the vehicle speed is outside the range of approximately 15 to approximately 100km/h while driving in 3 gear
When driving in gear 4 or higher at a vehicle speed other than approximately 15 to approximately 120km/h
When the transmission control computer, engine control computer, automatic transmission parts (shift solenoids, vehicle speed sensor, etc.) or electronically controlled throttle malfunctions

INDICATE.TITLE: When NAVI AI-SHIFT Downshifts Are Not Performed

ENTRY.PTXT: When the vehicle is turning
When VSC or TRC is operating

INDICATE.TITLE: NAVI AI-SHIFT may not operate correctly under the following conditions.

ENTRY.PTXT: When a tire is punctured
When the tire size differs from the specified size
When the spare tire is installed
When the road information in the navigation system differs from the actual road shape

INDICATE.TITLE: Under the following conditions, control is performed using only road gradient information, and control using corner information is not performed.

ENTRY.PTXT: When the navigation system malfunctions
When there is a communication malfunction between the navigation computer and engine control computer
When the navigation system has no map information
When the positioning accuracy of the navigation system decreases
When GPS signals cannot be received
When there is a road adjacent to the road being driven on
When the road is narrow (excluding national and prefectural roads)
When the road information in the navigation system differs from the actual road shape

HINT.PTXT: It may not operate correctly depending on the situation, so do not rely too heavily on NAVI AI-SHIFT; always pay attention to road conditions and drive at a safe speed.
